objective: Continue the full Oyatie mockup toward Bominal-grade completeness by upgrading the Cloud Ops cockpit from a sparse topology map into a dense cohesive operations command surface with topology, workload, release, FinOps, resource, Mail, Workflow, and evidence routes.

gap_analysis.source: live dashboard gap scan after Identity Command Center polish
findings_addressed: The Cloud Ops cockpit default Topology view still read as a sparse map with large low-information rectangles.
Cloud topology, workload inventory, deployment gates, FinOps, Mail, Workflow, and Evidence existed elsewhere but were not surfaced as one connected operations command surface.
The cloud surface needed more Bominal-style density: cell control, workload rows, release lanes, and explicit cross-suite routes.
Interactions needed to remain visually functional and local-only: no cloud, DNS, deployment, billing, or evidence backend operation.

implemented: Added a Cloud Operations Command Matrix immediately under the topology map in both hydrated and SSR static output.
Added Cell Control with selectable us-east-2, eu-west-1, and kr-seoul cells plus residency, rollback, and audit-sidecar metadata.
Added a Workloads table tying tenant-admin-api, workflow-runner, and audit-vault to cell, SLO, cost, and state.
Added Release Gates lanes for Jenkins parity, ArgoCD app, cosign verification, and audit-chain emit readiness.
Added a Routes panel that opens connected Workflow, Mail, Evidence, and FinOps surfaces locally.
Extended Cloud Ops fallback JavaScript with actions for cell selection, resource inventory route, deployment gates route, Workflow route, Mail route, Evidence route, and FinOps route.
Added dense flat CSS for the command matrix: low-radius cards, compact tables, lifecycle bars, and route buttons matching the Bominal tactical reference language.

observations: live server reachable on 127.0.0.1:3000 after 7 seconds

verification.command: Playwright smoke for #cloud-ops-cockpit, command matrix density, cell selector, inventory route, deployment gates route, Mail route, Evidence route, console/network health
pixelmatch secondary debug diffs against Bominal corporate, workflow-studio, and employees references cropped to shared viewport

observations.method: pixelmatch threshold=0.12, anti-alias ignored; secondary structural evidence only

visual_verdict.category_match: Bominal-style cloud operations command surface integrated with topology, workload inventory, deployment gates, FinOps, Mail, Workflow, and Evidence Spine
visual_verdict.verdict: The Cloud Ops cockpit no longer reads as a sparse topology sketch. It now has a dense command surface with cell controls, workload/cost/policy rows, release-readiness lanes, and cross-suite routes while preserving the flat tactical Bominal visual language.
improved_matches: Large sparse rectangles are now followed by operator-level controls and tables that make cloud state actionable.
Cloud, resource inventory, deployment gates, Workflow, Mail, Evidence, and FinOps are connected as one product surface rather than separate demo panels.
Cell selection and route buttons visibly change local state and navigate to connected surfaces without backend writes.
SSR and fallback/hydrated interactions both expose the denser operations command matrix.
remaining_differences: No real cloud resource, DNS, deploy, budget, mail, workflow, or evidence write is wired.
This advances the complete mockup; a final cross-surface completion audit is still required before claiming the whole dashboard is finished.

non_claims: No real cloud operation, deployment, DNS change, billing mutation, mail send, workflow execution, or audit-chain write occurs.
All interactions are visual-only local prototype state.
This is one additional polish slice toward the full mockup, not a claim that the entire dashboard is complete.
